bundle.shortDescription: Spheroidal geodesy on the Krasovsky 1940 ellipsoid
bundle.longDescription: Desktop version of PRIMA, a DOS teaching program for spheroidal geodesy written by geodesy students at DonNTU in the 1990s: radii of curvature, meridian and parallel arcs, map sheet frames and areas, direct and inverse geodetic problems, Gauss–Krüger coordinates.
bundle.copyright: Original program: A.V. Barteneva, V.I. Voronova, T.F. Kotolup, supervisor Yu.N. Gavrilenko (DonNTU). Port: Eugene Shmorgun.
